title: XENIA Arrival 0.1 orientation development draft
description: The document a host answers anyone with, no credential presented: what this place is, where its private view lives, and what a read does. It has no field about the caller. Matching this schema is a statement about shape only; it establishes nothing about a host, and a document that breaks an Arrival rule can still match.

as_of.description: When the host made this document. Null means not stated.

valid_until.description: Until when the host stands by this document. Null means not stated.

manifest.description: Address of the place's machine manifest, or null when it names none.

view.description: Where the private view lives. Naming the address grants no access to it.

credential_kinds.description: The host's own labels for the credentials the view address accepts. Arrival 0.1 does not define how a credential is presented.

cursor_parameter.description: Name of the query parameter that carries a cursor to the view address, or null when the view takes none.

read_effects.description: What reading the view writes, as the host declares it. Null means not stated.

reply_expected.description: Whether the host expects a reply to this read. Null means not stated.

not_established.description: Tokens for what this document does not establish. The sentence for each token is in the README.

participant_record_writes.description: Whether a read writes to the participant's own record.

operational_writes.description: Each write a read still causes outside the participant's record, named in the host's words.
